If you\'re experiencing connectivity issues with YouTube, resetting the VISITOR_DATA might help.
VISITOR_DATA is an identifier used by YouTube to track your session. When it\'s corrupted, it can cause:

• Connectivity errors
• Problems loading content
• Search failures
• Playback interruptions
Resetting VISITOR_DATA generates a new identifier and usually resolves these issues.
This works for both anonymous users and users signed in.
